change.after: "enabled by default; requires tsdb and v13 schema"

consequence.statement: If the schema is not tsdb with v13, Loki won't start because structured metadata is enabled by default.
consequence.remediation: Use tsdb and v13 schema (see Structured Metadata, Open Telemetry, Schemas and Indexes) before upgrading.

assertion.statement: Structured metadata is now enabled by default and requires the tsdb index and v13 schema, otherwise Loki won't start.
